checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Starts with storefront, retaining striped awning and outdoor tables
must.why: Frame at 0.9s shows the striped awning and folding tables/chairs; it is a tighter vertical recomposition with the window and door altered slightly, and the plant and blue door are lost.

must.item: Latte and pastry counter recognisable in later shots
must.why: The leaf-foam latte matches the photo and the croissant counter with staff, lamp and window matches.

must.item: Opening text exactly 'Maple Street Café', closing text exactly 'Your morning starts here'
must.why: Both read correctly. The closing text overlaps the croissants slightly.

must.item: Gentle visible movement and framed without stretching
must.why: Frames show a push-in on the storefront and a slow glide on the croissants, with no visible stretching.

must.item: Vertical, ~9 s, soft upbeat music with no speech
must.why: It is vertical and about 9.4 s with audio present. The music and any speech can't be judged from the numbers.

faults.what: The storefront is re-rendered: the awning is cropped and the window and door are slightly changed. The side door and plant are gone, and the awning looks a bit different.
The closing text sits over the croissants and the glass case, which lowers legibility slightly.
The croissant shot shifts perspective as the camera glides, and the croissants look a little regenerated.
The latte frame is cropped tight, so the cup is cut off at the edges.
The latte shot was not sampled at its mid-point. Steam and slow motion are not visible.

summary: The reel came out vertical with all three recognisable shots in the right order and both text lines spelled correctly. The main weaknesses are mild AI recomposition of the storefront and text placed over busy croissants.
